marks.q: Trading in 2026 has started strongly so far, which bolsters our confidence that we can deliver another consecutive year of growth in revenues and Adjusted EBITDA for the full year.

The strong 1H 2026 performance and the positive response to pending games are expected to combine to build a profitable cushion although this will be offset by the slower than expected initial launch of STARSEEKER.
